settings.subtitle: We fund community-led work across the Alder River region: neighborhoods, rivers, early reading and paid job training. Short applications, flexible money, long commitments.

settings.headline: A region where every community has what it needs to
settings.body:
Eleanor and James Alder made their fortune from the forests of this valley. In 1993 they gave most of it back, asking that it be spent by people who know the region and trusted to the people doing the work.

Thirty-three years later, that is still how we work. We fund groups that are led by the communities they serve, we keep our applications short, and we stay for the long haul.

values.title: Trust first
values.text: Most of our grants are flexible money. Grantees know best what their work needs.

values.title: Stay longer
values.text: Our average grant lasts two years. Some partners have been with us for twenty.

values.title: Less paperwork
values.text: A five-question letter of inquiry, and you can reuse reports you wrote for other funders.
